title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Add a set of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) agent templates, language-specific tool-calling examples (Python + TypeScript), and docs site quickstarts. Motivation: provide battle-tested examples and copy-pasteable templates for teams adopting RAG/agent patterns with Redwood. This PR includes: 1) RAG agent templates (email-answering, knowledge-base Q&A) under templates/rag/, documented configuration for retriever, chunking, and prompt templates; 2) examples/agents/tool-calling in Python and TypeScript demonstrating tool registration, safe tool calling, and structured responses; 3) docs/quickstarts/rag-agent.md and site navigation updates so quickstarts appear under "Quickstarts -> Agents"; 4) a short evaluation harness example used to validate end-to-end tool invocation safety. Checklist: - [x] add templates and examples - [x] docs quickstart and navigation updates - [x] unit tests for example helpers - [x] lint and formatting - [x] docs preview working Notes: kept changes intentionally minimal and example-first (no runtime changes). Related Linear tasks: ENG-6723 (RAG quickstarts), DOC-1189 (agent examples).
